name: Rockfall

stealth.details: (trained) to spot the weakened areas of the walls

disable: DC 33 Crafting check (expert) or DC 37 Athletics check (expert) to shore up the crumbling walls

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves into the hazard's area.

---
Effect A nearby wall collapses on the creature, dealing 6d10+27 bludgeoning damage (DC 34 basic Reflex save save). On a failed save, the creature is also Immobilized until it Escapes. On a critical failure, the creature is also knocked Prone. The area then becomes difficult terrain.

text: Rubble from the damaged walls falls on creatures that move into the area.
